label: prf:hadron-unique
title: Proof of uniqueness of hadrons up to braid isotopy
html: Proof. Two braids representing hadrons with identical crossing partitions are equivalent in H_n(R, q) if and only if they share a Hecke normal form. The Markov trace provides an isotopy invariant \mathrm{tr}_M(\beta) = J_L(q). Braid isotopy preserves the Hecke class. For hadrons with identical partitions and localisations, Gröbner–Shirshov reduction guarantees a canonical normal form representative. This representative is unique in H_n(R, q). Therefore, the Hecke normal form completely determines the hadron up to isotopy.
